scope: One evidence-backed correction for demonstrated physical pole curvature; experimental waveform-only shared carrier, not a production cutover
model: Shared alpha(t)=alpha_mid+alpha_slope*tau+0.5*alpha_curvature*tau^2 and corresponding frequency polynomial; integrate into cubic log-envelope/phase, profile ONLY constant channel offsets/cos/sin coefficients
comparison: All48 original measured critical-only controls and all48 frozen-shape exact-carrier controls from the completed transport diagnostic; compare to their saved linear fits
initialization: Saved measured-waveform linear fit only; both curvatures start0. No physical poles, designs, speeds or true end growth in fitter inputs
bounds: Reuse existing measured FFT frequency-mid, alpha-mid, slope and solver bounds. Curvature bounds are2*the existing slope bound/window span, equivalent to allowing at most the old maximum slope change across the window. Frequency slope and curvature each receive half the remaining physical-band slack. Keep both growth signs; explicit failure for unusable input/warm start/bounds
pass_checks: UNCHANGED original48-control scoring: all48 interior successful, all end poles match, all signs correct, clean stationary max error<=.001/s, noisy stationary median error<=archived LS median+.05/s, ramp MAE lower than both stationary and LS separately clean/iid1. Report native linear comparison and frozen-carrier mechanism control; lower SSE alone is insufficient
decision: Accept only a measured physical improvement with preserved guardrails; failed correction informs transport-aware iteration, not abandonment of P4 or relaxed thresholds
limitations: No ordinary-mixture, headroom or warning qualification
Frozen-carrier controls use oracle physics only for diagnosis
